messages:
jose: Heads-up-- docs preview failed on my PR updating the python SDK snippet. linkcheck found a dead link and Vale flagged a wording style rule.

anna: copy the failure output? happy to do a 1-line patch.

jose: paste below:
```
Linkcheck:
- https://old.examples.net/sdk/python/auth -> 404

Vale:
- docs/sdk/python/auth.md: 'is recommended' -> wording (VALE/BePassive)

md-lint:
- docs/sdk/python/auth.md: trailing spaces on fenced code block header
```

sarah: thanks. best fix is to point to https://docs.redwood.com/sdk/python/auth (our canonical host) and change "is recommended" -> "we recommend" or rephrase.

ci-bot: rebuild queued for PR-2345 at 1954321300. tests: linkcheck, vale, lint.

jose: i can open a tiny follow-up PR with the link swap and wording change now. will also strip trailing whitespace.

anna: if you tag me i'll review quickly. im in meetings until 3pm PT but can do a quick approve after.

docs-bot: note: small wording changes sometimes trigger translation smoke. if this touches i18n files please add "no-translate" label.

jose: not touching i18n, just snippets. PR-2356 opened: small fixes (link, wording, whitespace). adding reviewers @anna @sarah. changelog: "fix python auth snippet link, rephrase passive phrase, fix code fence whitespace"

anna: glancing now. code looks fine. one tiny nit: use single quotes in the inline example for consistency with nearby snippets.

jose: good call. i'll update the snippet to single quotes in the same PR.

ci-bot: PR-2356 docs-preview run complete: linkcheck=0, vale=0, lint=0.

sarah: green CI, i'm approving. looks safe. merge window is at 21:00 UTC, but if it's small we can land earlier.

anna: approved. if no objections i'll let jose merge once the window opens.

jose: thanks all. planning to merge at 20:50 UTC to avoid the 21:00 rush. pinging in #release-war-room as well.

anna: 44D good plan.

jose: merged. thanks!
